claim: A user can label an independently verified remote device fingerprint approved, revoked, or re-approved for one local installation and project; this current-state preference does not authenticate a person, propagate to collaborators, retain decision history, disconnect a peer, or change relay access.
commands: node ../scripts/run-with-heartbeat.mjs --timeout-seconds 120 --heartbeat-seconds 30 -- npm exec vitest run src/workspace/ResearchPresence.ui.test.tsx src/workspace/deviceIdentity.test.ts src/workspace/signedPresencePublisher.test.ts src/workspace/presenceModel.test.ts
proved: Native state is scoped to installation, project stable ID, and canonical Ed25519 SHA-256 key ID; unapproved is derived rather than persisted.
Approve, revoke, and re-approve require the exact expected current state and serialize through one native lock.
The strict registry rejects unknown fields, invalid status/timestamps, oversize content, more than 64 projects, and more than 64 decisions in one project without changing the saved primary.

Persistence syncs a bounded temporary file, rotates the primary to a recovery copy, restores on final-rename failure, prefers a valid primary, recovers a missing primary, and fails closed on a malformed primary.

Only independently verified remote presence proofs receive controls; the product exposes a short fingerprint, local approval state, one-at-a-time mutation controls, accessible errors, and explicit no-relay-access copy.
notProved: A local decision is signed, append-only, tamper-resistant from the same OS user, shared with another installation, or retained as an audit history.
A self-issued key is bound to a person, organization, account, trusted enrollment, project role, or authoritative participant identity.
Revoking a local label disconnects a peer, removes room access, revokes an invitation, blocks Yjs or MCP operations, or propagates to collaborators.
Key rotation/recovery, trusted time, exact same-context replay prevention, or signed durable research events exists.
Physical packaged two-install interaction, cross-platform app-data behavior, or five-client soak has passed.
